sentences.text:
Petitioner has been made an accused in connection with Lohardaga (M) P.S. Case No. 40/2022,
registered under Sections 376(2)(n)/ 313/ 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of learned C.J.M., Lohardaga.
Co-accused Danish Hajam had induced the informant to enter into physical relationship on the pretext of marriage and later on he refused to marry her.
It was submitted that the informant was a married lady and she has lodged a case mainly under Section 498-A of the Indian Penal Code against her husband vide Kanke P. S. case no. 73/2018.
It was further submitted that the allegation that petitioner has induced the informant for entering into sexual relationship on the pretext of marriage is totally false and fabricated.
Petitioner happens to be father of Danish Hajam.
It was further submitted that the co-accused Danish Hajam has been granted regular bail by this court earlier.

Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case, the petitioner named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Twenty Thousand only) with two Musan Hajam @ Md. Muslim @ Md. Muslim ... vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ...
